input_box_content.user_input_content:
=== CHARACTER LOCK — STRICT ===

RIVEN:

Use the provided Riven reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve Riven's exact facial identity, facial structure, pale-blonde hair, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing and armor design, sword design, overall silhouette, and grounded warrior appearance.

Riven must remain unmistakably the same character throughout the entire video.

This scene takes place many years after Riven's childhood, before she has joined the army.

Her original character design must remain unchanged.

Do not redesign her costume.

Do not change her hairstyle.

Do not change her body proportions.

Do not replace or redesign her sword.

Riven has practiced swordsmanship for many years.

She is fast, physically capable, confident, and highly skilled, but she still has less experience than her father.

Her swordsmanship should emphasize speed, committed attacks, precise footwork, and strong physical control.

Her movement must remain grounded and human.


FATHER:

Use the provided Father reference image as the strict primary visual reference for Riven's father.

Preserve his recognizable facial appearance, age, hairstyle, facial hair, body proportions, clothing design, and grounded former-warrior appearance.

He is older than Riven and no longer fights with youthful speed, but he is an experienced former warrior.

His swordsmanship is economical, calm, precise, and extremely efficient.

He does not waste movement.

He relies on timing, positioning, footwork, and experience rather than speed or flashy attacks.

He knows Riven's habits extremely well.

His physical performance should communicate quiet confidence and many years of experience.

Do not make him frail.

Do not make him clumsy.

Do not portray him as an elderly helpless man.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

Use the provided village/home reference as the environmental reference.

The scene takes place in the familiar dirt-and-grass training area beside Riven's family cottage.

Maintain the recognizable family home:

weathered timber and stone construction,
rough stone foundation,
sloped roof,
small chimney,
wooden door,
nearby chopping block,
stacked firewood,
simple fence,
large old tree,
and open training space beside the cottage.

The surrounding village remains peaceful.

Rugged mountains rise beyond the green valley.

Natural afternoon daylight.

Gentle mountain wind.

No army appears in this scene.

No additional characters are needed.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.

Natural human movement.

Grounded physical interaction.

Realistic sword weight.

Realistic weapon contact.

Realistic cloth and hair physics.

Maintain strict facial identity, costume consistency, weapon consistency, and body proportions throughout the whole video.

The sparring choreography must look like two people who have trained together for many years.

Keep the fight readable.

Use deliberate cinematic camera placement.

Allow exchanges to play out clearly instead of hiding them behind excessive cuts.

No rapid montage.

No exaggerated slow motion.

No wire-fu.

No impossible acrobatics.

No spinning for spectacle.

No supernatural abilities.

No magical effects.

No glowing weapons.

No injury.

No blood.

This is controlled training between father and daughter, not a lethal fight.

All character dialogue in this video must be spoken in natural ENGLISH ONLY.

Use clear natural English pronunciation.

Every written dialogue line must be spoken verbatim by the specified character.

Do not translate the dialogue.

No Chinese or Mandarin.

No Vietnamese.

No Japanese.

No Korean.

No other spoken language.

No additional spoken dialogue.

No background intelligible conversations.

Accurate visible lip synchronization whenever a character speaks.

No narration.

No voice-over.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No visible text.

No watermark.

No logo.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Adult Riven and her father are already standing opposite each other in the familiar training yard beside their cottage.

Both are holding swords.

This is a familiar sparring routine between them.

There is no anger between them.

There is no family argument.

Neither character is trying to injure the other.

Riven wants to beat him.

Her father wants to test her.

The first exchange demonstrates that although Riven has become highly skilled, her father still understands her habits extremely well.

He reads her attacks, controls distance, and defeats the exchange through experience rather than superior speed.

After being stopped, Riven begins again.

This time she changes.

Instead of immediately attacking, she observes him.

She becomes more patient.

She uses controlled footwork and a feint to create a new angle.

For the first time in the scene, Riven successfully gets through her father's defense.

The emotional payoff must remain restrained.

No celebration.

No sentimental reaction.

No hug.

No speech about being proud.

The father simply recognizes what happened.

Then he asks her to do it again.


=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — READY

Begin low to the ground.

Two pairs of boots stand opposite each other on the worn dirt of the training yard.

Slowly reveal Adult Riven facing her father.

Both hold their swords naturally.

Riven is focused but comfortable.

Her father is completely calm.

Their body language should immediately suggest that they have done this many times before.

The father looks at Riven.

He asks naturally:

"Ready?"

Riven gives him a small confident look.

She answers:

"Always."

They settle into their stances.

Do not immediately rush into exaggerated combat.

Hold the tension briefly.

Then Riven moves first.


Shot 2 — EXPERIENCE

Riven attacks with a fast but controlled diagonal strike.

Her father uses a small efficient parry.

Metal meets metal with realistic physical impact.

Riven immediately changes direction.

Her father is already moving.

Another controlled parry.

Riven steps forward and pressures him with another attack.

Her father gives ground only when necessary.

His movements remain compact.

He does not overpower Riven with brute force.

He reads her.

Riven attempts to change angle.

Her father anticipates it.

He redirects her blade and steps just outside her line of attack.

Before Riven can recover, the father's sword stops lightly against her shoulder.

Both immediately freeze.

The exchange is over.

No injury.

Riven looks at the blade near her shoulder.

Then at her father.

She is mildly frustrated, but not angry.

Her father lowers his sword.

He says simply:

"Again."

Riven resets.

This time her expression changes.

Less impatience.

More concentration.


Shot 3 — HER FEET

Riven and her father face each other again.

Riven does not immediately attack.

Her father notices.

Hold briefly on their eyes.

Riven studies his stance.

The father waits.

Then Riven moves.

She attacks.

Her father parries.

Riven does not force another immediate strike.

She changes distance.

The father adjusts.

Show a brief close detail of Riven's feet.

Her foot placement is precise and deliberate.

This should visually echo the lesson she learned as a child without using a flashback or voice-over.

Riven creates an angle.

She gives her father the beginning of an attack he recognizes.

He reacts to it.

But it is a feint.

Riven changes direction.

Her father realizes what she is doing and blocks.

The two swords meet again.

Riven stays balanced.

She continues moving instead of fighting against the collision.

Her father counters.

Riven catches the counter.

Their blades separate.

Riven shifts her feet again.

She moves around his line rather than directly through it.

For a brief moment, father and daughter are genuinely evenly matched.

Keep the choreography clean and readable.

Riven sees an opening.

She takes it.


Shot 4 — AGAIN

Riven steps into the new angle created by her footwork.

Her father begins to recover his defense.

This time he is slightly too late.

Riven brings her sword under complete control and stops the blade close to him before making harmful contact.

Freeze the physical action naturally.

Silence.

Neither moves.

Riven realizes what just happened.

She has finally gotten through his defense.

Do not make Riven celebrate.

Do not make her laugh.

Do not make her boast.

Her breathing is slightly heavier from the exchange.

Her father slowly looks toward Riven's sword.

Then he looks directly at her.

His expression changes only slightly.

Not shock.

Not sentimental pride.

Recognition.

Riven waits for his reaction.

The father calmly steps away from the blade.

He raises his sword again.

He returns to his stance.

Then he says:

"Again."

Riven watches him for a moment.

A very small confident smile appears.

She raises her sword.

She returns to stance.

Father and daughter face each other once more.

CUT before either character attacks.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Riven and her father remain in the training yard beside their cottage.

Both still hold their swords.

Riven has successfully broken through her father's defense during the previous exchange.

Her father has acknowledged it only by asking her to continue.

Neither character is injured.

Neither character is angry.

The sparring session is not finished.

Riven is standing in a ready stance opposite her father.

Her father is also ready.

They are about to begin another exchange.

No army has appeared.

Riven has not spoken about joining the army.

Riven has not announced that she is leaving.

Do not resolve her future decision in this scene.

CUT.


=== MOOD ===

Grounded.

Physical.

Controlled.

Competitive without hostility.

Quietly satisfying.

Father and daughter understand each other through movement more than words.

The scene should demonstrate the difference between their fighting styles:

Riven:
younger,
faster,
more aggressive,
technically skilled,
physically confident.

Father:
older,
more experienced,
economical,
patient,
extremely good at reading Riven.

The important progression is:

Riven attacks confidently
→ Father reads her and wins the exchange
→ "Again."
→ Riven becomes patient
→ she watches instead of rushing
→ precise footwork
→ feint
→ new angle
→ Riven finally gets through Father's defense
→ silence
→ Father recognizes her progress
→ "Again."

The final "Again." should not feel like criticism.

It should feel like the natural response of a teacher who knows his student has just reached a new level.

Do not make the scene sentimental.

Do not include a long conversation.

Do not mention the army.

Do not include recruitment.

Do not include departure.

Do not include a goodbye.

Do not explain the childhood footwork callback verbally.

Let the swordsmanship tell the story.
